classification_rule.source_diagnostic_policy: The original lexer, parser, or checker diagnostic remains primary. R10 internal diagnostics report a failed canonical or artifact verification boundary and are never ordinary user-source diagnostics.
classification_rule.repository_failure_policy: Repository-only failure IDs name static validator or corpus defects and must not be added to the public compiler diagnostic catalog.

deterministic_internal_priority.trigger: A recovery, error, missing-expression, invalid, unresolved, or analysis-only node reaches CanonicalHirH1 sealing.
deterministic_internal_priority.priority_rule: Emit once for the earliest canonical node ordered by HirNodeId. Preserve the original source diagnostic; do not construct canonical HIR.

deterministic_internal_priority.trigger: A canonical identity is unknown to, or has no unique row in, the bound lowering registry.
deterministic_internal_priority.priority_rule: After recovery exclusion, select the first failure ordered by schema-version identity, canonical HIR identity, and row ID.

deterministic_internal_priority.trigger: The recomputed executable-capability receipt does not exactly bind the HIR schema, MIR schema, lowering registry, reachability, provided set, or unsupported count.
deterministic_internal_priority.priority_rule: Use capability_mismatch_subpriority; preserve Verified<CanonicalHirH1> and reject only ExecutableHirH1 construction.

deterministic_internal_priority.trigger: An entire ordered responsibility axis is absent from the MIR projection.
deterministic_internal_priority.priority_rule: Use the first affected HirNodeId and then the fixed eleven-axis order.

deterministic_internal_priority.trigger: A retained responsibility axis changes value, ordering, membership, or MIR residue.
deterministic_internal_priority.priority_rule: Use the first affected HirNodeId and then the fixed eleven-axis order.

deterministic_internal_priority.trigger: Deterministic relowering or canonical encode/decode/re-encode does not reproduce the supplied MIR semantic bytes and ordered projection.
deterministic_internal_priority.priority_rule: Emit only after earlier canonical, capability, and responsibility checks pass.

managed_reference_projection_priority.trigger: The recomputed closed safepoint set differs from the managed-memory plan.
A root partition, entry, trace descriptor or generation is missing, extra, duplicate, unordered or stale.
Canonical root and safepoint bytes do not reproduce the claimed receipt digest.
Root verification, publication, operation entry, outcome commit or release is out of order.
A managed-derived raw or interior pointer survives a safepoint or FFI boundary.
A JIT generation retires outside unpublished-and-zero-leases state.
xVM, Object AOT and JIT disagree on a logical managed-memory observation.

catalog_row.fixit_policy: No release-verifier fix-it; repair the originating frontend defect and preserve its original source diagnostic.
catalog_row.message: A recovery or analysis-only node reached CanonicalHirH1 sealing.
catalog_row.notes: Internal canonical-seal invariant. It does not replace or duplicate the originating lexer/parser/checker diagnostic; product emission receipt NOT_RUN.

catalog_row.fixit_policy: No source fix-it; restore exact canonical-identity and lowering-registry closure.
catalog_row.message: A canonical HIR identity has no unique lowering-registry mapping.
catalog_row.notes: Internal release-verifier diagnostic; repository missing/duplicate/extra row defects retain separate validator failure IDs; product emission receipt NOT_RUN.

catalog_row.fixit_policy: No source fix-it; recompute and bind the exact HIR/MIR schema, lowering registry, reachability, and capability sets.
catalog_row.message: The MIR capability receipt does not exactly cover the reachable canonical HIR lowering keys.
catalog_row.notes: Verified canonical HIR remains valid and inert; only ExecutableHirH1 construction fails. Internal release-verifier diagnostic; product emission receipt NOT_RUN.

catalog_row.fixit_policy: No source fix-it; restore the exact ordered HIR responsibility value and MIR residue.
catalog_row.message: A retained HIR responsibility axis changed during MIR projection.
catalog_row.notes: Use RCTS_RESPONSIBILITY_AXIS_DROPPED when the entire axis is absent. Internal release-verifier diagnostic; product emission receipt NOT_RUN.

catalog_row.fixit_policy: No source fix-it; deterministically relower and replace the nonmatching MIR artifact.
catalog_row.message: Deterministic relowering did not reproduce the supplied canonical MIR semantic bytes and ordered projection.
catalog_row.notes: Independent matching digest strings are insufficient. Internal release-verifier diagnostic; product emission receipt NOT_RUN.

existing_diagnostic_reuse.reuse_scope: Only an entirely absent responsibility axis.
Only unresolved resolver references before canonical HIR sealing; it does not report lowering-row, capability, responsibility-projection, or pair-relowering defects.
Exact pre-HIR rejection for fixture R10-HM-NEG-013 where ACTOR_MESSAGE is paired with VIRTUAL_SLOT. Other invalid surface states retain their own existing source diagnostic.

repository_only_failures.trigger: A current or selected Preview reachable dispatch key has no lowering row.
Two or more lowering rows claim the same schema-bound dispatch key.
The identity catalog, profile classification, or extra-row set differs from the closed 128/102/111 model.
A row references an unknown MIR operation, terminator, capability, semantic-operation identity, or an unknown vertex or directed cycle in the lowering-plan dependency graph.
An internal diagnostic is missing, duplicated, misclassified as source-facing, or bound to the wrong deterministic priority.
Any R10 product lane changes from NOT_RUN without exact target-bound execution evidence.

semantic_dependency_resolutions.description: The closed semantic_operation_id registry and its exact mapping for all 102/111 rows are not present in the controlling draft; the lowering-row schema therefore validates ID shape and requires external registry resolution without inventing IDs.
semantic_dependency_resolutions.resolution: The exact 48-entry total semantic-operation map is bound by deeplus.mir-machine-registry/r1 and rechecked for every operation plan step.

semantic_dependency_resolutions.description: The exact existing source diagnostic for each invalid pre-HIR call-mode/target combination is not selected by the controlling draft. The fixtures require an existing source-checker diagnostic without creating a new R10 source ID.
semantic_dependency_resolutions.resolution: R10-HM-NEG-013 reuses active current-source diagnostic RECEIVER_MODE_MISMATCH; no total invalid-pair diagnostic map is claimed.

semantic_dependency_resolutions.description: A dependency-cycle failure is provisionally owned by R10_HM_LOWERING_TARGET_UNKNOWN; Design_ must confirm that this validator ID intentionally covers invalid target-reference graphs or split a dedicated repository-only ID.
semantic_dependency_resolutions.resolution: R10_HM_LOWERING_TARGET_UNKNOWN owns both unknown vertices and directed dependency cycles; failure_detail distinguishes DEPENDENCY_CYCLE.
